skill.name: peer-review
skill.description: Evaluate scientific manuscripts, grant proposals, and presentations with structured checks for methods, statistics, reproducibility, ethics, figures, and reporting standards.
skill.summary: Structured peer review guidance for scientific manuscripts, grants, and presentations.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Scientific reviews can miss methodology, statistics, reproducibility, and reporting gaps. This skill provides a structured workflow for constructive manuscript, grant, and presentation review.
actual_capabilities: Guides section-by-section review across abstracts, methods, results, discussion, and references.
Checks statistical reporting, study design, sample size, controls, and missing data handling.
Assesses reproducibility items such as data availability, code sharing, protocols, and reporting checklists.
Flags figure, table, image integrity, accessibility, and presentation slide issues.
Structures feedback into summaries, major comments, minor comments, author questions, and recommendations.
Maps reviews to standards such as CONSORT, PRISMA, STROBE, ARRIVE, MIAME, and MINSEQE.
limitations: Does not replace a qualified human reviewer or editor.
Requires the manuscript, proposal, or slide content to be provided by the user.
Cannot verify raw data, hidden analyses, or laboratory records unless supplied.
May require field-specific expert judgment for specialized methods.

use_cases.title: Review Journal Manuscripts
use_cases.description: Create balanced peer review reports with clear major concerns, minor comments, and author questions.

use_cases.title: Improve Pre-Submission Drafts
use_cases.description: Find methodology, statistics, reporting, and reproducibility gaps before submitting a paper.

use_cases.title: Assess Grant Applications
use_cases.description: Evaluate research aims, feasibility, methods, rigor, ethics, and expected impact in proposals.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Manuscript Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this manuscript for scope, novelty, and main strengths. Provide a short initial assessment before detailed comments.

prompt_templates.title: Check Methods and Statistics
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the methods and statistical reporting in this manuscript. Identify major validity risks, missing details, and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Reproducibility and Ethics
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate reproducibility, data availability, code sharing, ethics approvals, consent, conflicts, and reporting guideline compliance for this study.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Full Peer Review Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a journal-style peer review report. Include summary, recommendation, major comments, minor comments, questions for authors, and required revisions.

output_examples.input: Review a biomedical manuscript with unclear randomization and no power analysis.
output_examples.output: The report identifies randomization detail and power justification as major concerns, then suggests specific methods revisions.

output_examples.input: Assess a systematic review draft for reporting completeness.
output_examples.output: The review checks PRISMA-related items, including protocol registration, search strategy, selection process, extraction methods, and bias assessment.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a scientific slide deck before a conference talk.
output_examples.output: The feedback lists slide-level readability, layout, contrast, citation, timing, and content issues with practical revision priorities.

best_practices: Provide the manuscript, target venue, article type, and review criteria.
Ask for separate passes on methods, statistics, ethics, and figures for complex work.
Keep final comments evidence-based and tied to specific manuscript sections.
anti_patterns: Using the skill to invent reviewer claims without manuscript evidence.
Requesting extra experiments that are outside the stated research question.
Treating the output as a final editorial decision without expert review.

faq.question: Can this skill review grant proposals?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess aims, methods, feasibility, significance, and reproducibility concerns in grant applications.

faq.question: Does it perform statistical calculations?
faq.answer: It can review reported statistical choices and flag concerns. It does not compute new analyses unless data and instructions are provided.

faq.question: Can it check reporting guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes. It references common guidelines such as CONSORT, PRISMA, STROBE, ARRIVE, MIAME, and MINSEQE.

faq.question: Can it review slide decks?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives image-based review guidance for scientific presentations and slide formatting.

faq.question: Does it replace domain experts?
faq.answer: No. It supports structured review, but specialized claims need qualified expert judgment.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill is structured for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
